headlines.text: 2022 brought us this moment: Chris Jericho vs. Bandido fought tooth and nail for the ROH World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.18 ? a genuinely great match. Bandido was challenging for gold for the very first time. In his first ROH title defense, Jericho no-sold the Code of Honor handshake, then survived a returning Bandido's suplex-hold display before making him submit to the Walls of Jericho.
That Wednesday in 2022, Juice Robinson touched down in AEW for the first time against Jon Moxley, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.52.
Flash back to 2022, when Toni Storm vs. Serena Deeb clashed for the AEW Women's World Title in a Lumberjack match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.70. Championship gold always raises the stakes.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2022, it marked the first-ever meeting between Bryan Danielson and Matt Menard, setting the tone as the night's opener on Dynamite, rated 4.66.
